records.text: Guidance given to Crystal Wilson for a UK-focused CV included using a clear, simple format with standard headings and ATS-readable layout; tailoring relevant keywords to each job description; listing work and education in reverse chronological order; accurately stating job titles, employers, locations, dates, qualifications, responsibilities, and achievements; and quantifying achievements where possible. Advice also covered professional contact details, a professional summary, relevant skills and certifications, and generally omitting personal details such as age and marital status. References need not usually be listed; they may be stated as available upon request.
